title: 卷一江湖少年 第七章明月夜刀光起2卷一江湖少年 第八章少年出城入江湖
slug: 梦启东梁第一四零六章蛛丝有毒

明月夜，刀光起
“龙啸，”
赵二手中长刀横在一侧，面对着杀意爆发的龙啸，冷声道，“今天送你上路。”
“口气不小。”
龙啸冷哼一声，也不废话，手中大刀发出一声减退的厉啸声，迎面向着赵二劈了过去，“先问过我手中的刀再说。”
转眼间，两人再次战在了一起。
与此同时，周边的海面上，长刀门的五条海船已经被龙啸带来的数十条小船所包围，长刀门的人居高临下，手中箭矢如雨点一般向着下方的小船倾泻而来。
但小船在海面上占据了体型小的优势，再加上移动灵活，是以大船上的箭矢只是延缓了他们登船的速度，并未造成太大的伤害。
这样双方僵持的局面很快便被打破，随着洪兴年一声令下，立即有人纵身跃入海中，手中持着手锯，从水面下向着海船的底部游来。
“小心水下！”
很快，大船上的人便发现了船底的异样。
“少爷，水底下有人，我们有两条船已经被凿穿开始进水了。”
收到下面人的禀报，赵飞的面色当即难看了下来。
“派人到水下去。”
赵飞目光扫过甲板上正在与赵二鏖战的龙啸，冷声道，“速战速决。”
“是。”
来人领命而去。
赵飞也缓缓抽出了手中的长刀，纵深跃下，闪身加入了两人的战团。
龙啸与赵二两人的实力原本就是在伯仲之间，在龙啸拼命的情况下，赵二勉强处于守势，如今有了赵飞的加入，龙啸顿时落入下风。

眼见得赵二久攻不下，龙啸心中本就着急，如今有了赵飞的加入，龙啸心中知道自己这次怕是真的回不去了。
心念至此，龙啸手中大刀荡开了赵飞两人的长刀，仰天长啸一声，内力激荡之下，啸声甚至掩盖了周边的厮杀声，向着远处滚滚而去。
听到龙啸的啸声，正在后方指挥手下登船的洪兴年不由得一怔，随即双眼变得通红了起来。
“继续冲，不要停”
，声音传出，洪兴年同样操起手中的长刀冲了上去。
他听懂了龙啸的啸声，那是在提醒他，对方已经提前发现了他们的意图并且早有准备，让他带着人先撤。
可洪兴年心中清楚，如果自己这次带人撤了，龙啸自己定然是无法脱身的，而且有了今日的厮杀，一旦长刀门与五音亭完成联姻，鲸蛟会将会成为平川城的历史。
随着洪兴年加入战团，鲸蛟会一方的攻势顿时变得更加凌厉起来，没多久就有两条船被攻了上去。
长刀门这一方，由于赵二和赵飞这两个顶尖战力都被龙啸牵制在中央的大船上，余下的四条船多是长刀门的寻常武者，自身实力本就不强，再加上是在自己并不擅长的海面上，战力又打了一个折扣，此消彼长之下，一旦被鲸蛟会的人登船，船上的形势便急转直下了。
眼见得鲸蛟会得人已经占据了上风，洪兴年抬眼看向龙啸所在得大船，若没有猜错得话，那个小乞丐定然也是在那条大船上了。
挥刀将身前挡路得长刀门武者解决掉，洪兴年抬手将一把长刀向前面的大床甩去，“咄”
的一声，长刀稳稳的刺入海船的船身上，刀柄处的缆绳在反震之力的作用下微微摇晃着。
洪兴年见状脚尖一点，身形如一只凌空大雁一般掠过两船之间的海面，脚尖在缆绳上借了一次力，身形便已经来到了龙啸几人所在的海船上。
见到洪兴年来到，龙啸手中大刀发出一声声厉啸，将赵飞与赵二两人死死的拖在原地，同时向洪兴年吼道，“去找人。”
眼见龙啸一时无恙，洪兴年也不废话，直接闪身向着一旁的船舱而去。
此时双方人马大都在外面交战，洪兴年如入无人之境般闯入了船舱之中，快速的在各个舱室之间寻找起来。
舱外，赵飞与赵二两人眼尖的洪兴年进了船舱，却是没有如龙啸所料一般焦急起来，赵飞的眼中隐隐的露出一抹讥讽。
“不好，”
龙啸心中猛地一沉，瞬间便意识到了不对，“上当了。”
看到船上长刀门的人并没有前去阻拦洪兴年的意思，龙啸当即便反应了过来。

然而此时双方人马已经彻底的混在了一起，想要分开怕是只能等双方彻底分出胜负了。

On a bright moon night, the sword rises
"Dragon Roar,"
Zhao held the long sword in his second hand horizontally on one side. Facing the roar of the murderous dragon, he said in a cold voice, "I'll send you on your way today."
"The tone is not small."
Long Xiao snorted coldly and said no nonsense. The sword in his hand let out a sharp whistling sound and struck Zhao Er head-on. "Ask about the sword in my hand first."
In the blink of an eye, the two were fighting together again.
At the same time, on the surrounding sea, the five ships of the Changdaomen were surrounded by dozens of small boats brought by the dragon roar. The people of the Changdaomen were condescending, and arrows in their hands were raining down on the small boats below.
However, the small boat had the advantage of being small on the sea, coupled with its flexible movement, the arrows on the big boat only slowed down their boarding speed and did not cause much damage.
The stalemate between the two sides was quickly broken. Following Hong Xingnian's order, someone immediately jumped into the sea, holding a hand saw in his hand, and swam from the water towards the bottom of the ship.
"Be careful underwater!"
Soon, the people on the big ship discovered something strange at the bottom of the ship.
"Master, there are people under the water. Two of our boats have been punctured and started to take in water."
After receiving the report from the people below, Zhao Fei's expression immediately turned ugly.
"Send someone down to the water."
Zhao Fei glanced at Long Xiao who was fighting fiercely with Zhao Er on the deck, and said coldly, "Fight quickly."
"Yes."
The person who came took the order and left.
Zhao Fei also slowly took out the long knife in his hand, jumped down, and ducked to join the battle group of the two men.
The strength of Long Xiao and Zhao Er was originally between brothers. With Long Xiao's desperate efforts, Zhao Er was barely on the defensive. Now with Zhao Fei joining, Long Xiao suddenly fell into a disadvantage.
Seeing that Zhao Erjiu could not attack, Long Xiao was worried. Now with Zhao Fei joining, Long Xiao knew that he might not be able to go back this time.
With this thought in his mind, Long Xiao swung away Zhao Fei's and Zhao Fei's long knives with the big knife in his hand, and roared to the sky. Under the excitement of his internal energy, the roar even covered up the sounds of fighting around him, and rolled away into the distance.
Hearing the roar of the dragon, Hong Xingnian, who was directing his men to board the ship from behind, couldn't help but be startled, and then his eyes turned red.
"Keep rushing, don't stop"
, the sound came out, and Hong Xingnian also rushed forward with the long knife in his hand.
He understood the roar of the dragon, which reminded him that the other party had discovered their intentions in advance and had been prepared for him to lead his men to retreat first.
But Hong Xingnian knew clearly in his heart that if he led his people to withdraw this time, Long Xiao himself would definitely not be able to escape. Moreover, with today's fighting, once the marriage between Changdaomen and Wuyinting is completed, the Whale Dragon Society will become the history of Pingchuan City.
As Hong Xingnian joined the battle group, the Jingjiaohui's offensive suddenly became more fierce, and it didn't take long for two ships to be attacked.
On the Changdaomen side, since Zhao Er and Zhao Fei, the two top combat powers, were restrained by Long Xiao on the large ship in the center, the remaining four ships were mostly ordinary warriors from the Changdaomen. Their own strength was not strong. In addition, they were on the sea where they were not good at, and their combat power was further reduced. Under one situation, once people from the Whale Dragon Society boarded the ship, the situation on the ship took a turn for the worse.
Seeing that the Whale Dragon Club had the upper hand, Hong Xingnian raised his eyes and looked at the big ship where Long Xiao was. If he guessed correctly, the little beggar must also be on that big ship.
Swinging his sword to eliminate the warrior from the Changdao Sect who was blocking the way, Hong Xingnian raised his hand and threw a long sword towards the big bed in front of him, "Duh"
With a sound, the long knife stabbed steadily into the hull of the ship, and the cable at the handle swayed slightly under the force of the shock.
Seeing this, Hong Xingnian tiptoed, and like a flying goose, he flew across the sea between the two ships. He used his toes on the cable, and he had already arrived on the ship where Long Xiao and others were..
Seeing Hong Xingnian coming, Long Xiao let out a sharp scream from the sword in his hand, dragging Zhao Fei and Zhao Er to the spot, and at the same time shouted to Hong Xingnian, "Go find someone."
Seeing that Long Xiao was fine for the moment, Hong Xingnian didn't waste any time and walked directly towards the cabin on the side.
At this time, most of the people on both sides were fighting outside. Hong Xingnian broke into the cabin as if he was in no one's land, and quickly searched among the cabins.
Outside the cabin, Zhao Fei and Zhao Er, two sharp-eyed Hong Xingnian entered the cabin, but they did not become as anxious as Long Xiao expected. Zhao Fei had a hint of sarcasm in his eyes.
"Not good,"
Long Xiao's heart suddenly sank, and he immediately realized something was wrong, "I was fooled."
Seeing that the people at Changdaomen on the ship had no intention of stopping Hong Xingnian, Long Xiao immediately reacted.
However, at this time, the two sides have completely mixed together. If they want to separate, they may have to wait until the two sides completely decide the winner.
